title: Offer ruling alerts to Distinctive Mark
description: Through the Distinctive session: sending stack in zone Z0290267H9H3GQTVF6SK (check apex DMARC and MX first), plugin config with weekly and alert lists, migrate the existing signup form to /api/newsletter/subscribe.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Sending stack papyrus-newsletter-sending-distinctive deployed: distinctive-mark.com verified with DKIM, MAIL FROM bounce.distinctive-mark.com and SPF, and _dmarc p=none, all in zone Z0290267H9H3GQTVF6SK; configuration set papyrus-distinctive (siteId distinctive). Compliance footer uses the shared default postal address. Enablement instructions offered to the Distinctive session, which owns Distinctive-web and decides when to enable; use Papyrus 5.22.0 or later.
